label: All Article III federal judges
modeledUse: Large professional electorate with federal breadth and moderate regional diversity
primaryCaveat: Approximate count is a modeling preset rather than a current administrative roster

label: Federal appellate judges
modeledUse: Small high-status professional electorate with strong appellate screening
primaryCaveat: May overweight existing federal appellate pipeline and reduce democratic legibility

label: Judges from selected circuits
modeledUse: Regional or rotating-circuit electorate with lower coordination cost
primaryCaveat: Can amplify circuit-specific ideology or local professional capture

label: State supreme court justices
modeledUse: State high-court electorate with federalism and state-law experience
primaryCaveat: Judicial selection environments differ sharply across states

label: Federal and state high-court judges
modeledUse: Broad professional electorate combining federal and state high-court perspectives
primaryCaveat: Still a professional-guild electorate rather than a democratically elected body

label: Open to qualified lawyers
modeledUse: Broad eligibility outside the judicial career ladder
primaryCaveat: Less professional screening and higher uncertainty about judicial-role behavior

label: Sitting federal judges
modeledUse: Federal judicial eligibility pool with trial and appellate experience
primaryCaveat: Can underrepresent state constitutional and state-law perspectives

label: Federal appellate judges
modeledUse: Narrow appellate-judge eligibility pool with strong appellate filtering
primaryCaveat: Can reproduce the existing appellate pipeline and reduce candidate breadth

label: State high-court judges
modeledUse: State supreme court eligibility pool with state constitutional experience
primaryCaveat: State selection systems may import partisan or electoral incentives

label: Federal and state high-court judges
modeledUse: Broad high-court eligibility pool across federal and state systems
primaryCaveat: Comparability across court systems is synthetic and should not be treated as empirical calibration
